welcomeMessage: You can scaffold Swift projects using the scaffolding skill.

versions.changes: Fixed XcodeBuildMCP registration: added the missing "mcp" subcommand in args to prevent connection closure on startup.
Added OpenCode support through an opencode-plugin.js entry point that registers skills, MCP servers, and session-start context.

Migrated the legacy scaffolding command prompt to the scaffolding skill and registered it in info.json. Released self-contained common helper copies so the plugin package no longer depends on repository-level symlinks, while keeping hook configuration in hooks/hooks.json instead of generated common/hooks.json templates.
Kept Claude-specific AskUserQuestion access in command metadata while making the scaffolding prompt body portable across compatible agents.
Removed auto-update hook from SessionStart to prevent configuration issues
Restored auto-update hook; version tracking now uses CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA with migration from old .claude/ directory
Fixed hook deduplication issue when multiple plugins installed - each plugin now has its own hooks.json
Improved skill matching to support PluginName:skill prefix format in addition to skills array
Added skills array to info.json; improved skill matching in pre-tool-use hook
Improved skill/bash command matching in common infrastructure (using 'in' instead of 'startswith')
Updated pre-tool-use hook with configurable rules support (allow/deny/deny_once)
Version tracker now silently initializes on first run instead of showing entire version history
Fixed hooks path to use plugin-local common directory (plugins cannot reference external files)
Centralized hooks to common/hooks.json and made scripts self-configuring from plugin.json
Added version tracking with changelog notifications and refactored session hooks to use shared infrastructure
